description: Plan stacked, speaker-colored reaction captions from a word timeline and an explicit speaker palette. Flash-length words merge, overlaps stack, and unknown speakers stay uncolored. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

combine_gap_seconds.description: Maximum gap when combining a flash cue with the next same-speaker cue; defaults to 0.8.

frame_rate.description: Sequence frame rate used to snap times to frames; defaults to 30.

merge_gap_seconds.description: Same-speaker words closer than this become one cue; defaults to 0.12 so a short pause can start a new line.

min_hold_seconds.description: Minimum duration kept after clamping a cue to a shot change; defaults to 0.35.

min_solo_cue_seconds.description: Cues shorter than this merge with the next same-speaker cue; defaults to 0.45.

shot_changes.description: Optional labeled cut points. A matching speaker's caption will not start before they appear on screen when a readable hold remains.

speaker_label.description: Speaker who becomes visible at this cut.

time_seconds.description: Shot-change time in source seconds; must be non-decreasing.

speaker_palette.description: Known speakers and their exact #RRGGBB colors. Missing labels are returned as uncertain and never receive a guessed color.

speaker_label.description: Speaker label exactly as used in word_timeline.

word_timeline.description: Caller-supplied word-timed transcript for one Premiere source item. Words must be ordered by start time and bound to the transcript revision returned by get_clip_transcript_uxp. Different labeled speakers may overlap; same-speaker words may not, even when another speaker is between them.

words.description: Ordered word tokens with source-time boundaries.

name: plan_reaction_captions

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Plan Reaction Captions
